maria: Quick design check — found a few UX nits in invite flow and roles matrix during hallway usability. TL;DR: empty state CTA ambiguous ("Create seat" vs "Invite people"), SSO toggle label confusing, focus trap when opening roles matrix with keyboard, and audit log left nav loses context when drilling into details. Screens in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/invite-flows eli: Thanks — can you attach repro steps? I couldn't repro the focus trap yesterday but that might be with the feature flag off. maria: Repro: org settings > Members > Invite > click "Choose role" then Tab through keyboard nav — after opening the matrix, Shift+Tab doesn't return to close button. Happens in Chrome + VoiceOver. Steps pasted below. sam: I'll try on staging. Which deploy had the new UX? invite-bot: deployed invites v2 at 2024-10-09T14:12Z :rocket: zoe: Accessibility: agree this is a focus management bug. Also role cells lack aria-labels — screen readers only hear "button". Quick fix: add role name + short description to aria-label and ensure modal uses aria-modal=true and focus returns to opener on close. sam: I'll push a patch. Snippet I plan to use: ```
``` eli: UX copy: empty invite state currently says "Create a seat" which users read as billing. Suggest "Invite teammates" + subtext "Create seats as you invite". @kevin thoughts? kevin: Prefer "Invite teammates" with secondary "Add users and assign roles". Also SSO toggle is problematic — labeled "Require SSO for new users" but acts as an org-wide enforcement. We should add microcopy: "When enabled, new accounts must use SSO. Existing users unaffected." and a confirm for turning on. maria: Agree on copy. Audit log nav: when viewing an event the left nav collapses and filters are lost. Users want to return to their filtered list. Can we persist filters in the URL and add a clear "Back to filtered results" link? eli: Implementation idea: push filter state to history (history.pushState) so browser back returns to filtered list, and show a prominent link above event details "Back to audit log results". zoe: a11y nit: ensure the back link is keyboard-focusable and has aria-label "Back to audit log results". Also visible focus outline for keyboard users. sam: I'll open a PR with three focused commits: 1) aria labels and focus trap fix for roles matrix, 2) empty state copy update, 3) audit-log state preservation + back link. ETA EOD tomorrow. maria: Awesome, thanks. @eli can you review the updated copy in Figma after the PR? :eyes: eli: Yep, will review and drop comments. :thumbsup: invite-bot: reminder — invite flow UX doc updated: https://docs.internal/redwood/invite-flow-ux (edited)
